# Alis Behavioral Health

> Alis Behavioral Health provides comprehensive adolescent mental health treatment in Denver and Westminster, Colorado, specializing in evidence-based therapies for teens facing anxiety, depression, self-harm, and emotional dysregulation.

Alis Behavioral Health is a non-hospital youth behavioral health facility offering multiple levels of care including Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP), Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP), and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT). The organization accepts major insurance providers and emphasizes family involvement in treatment outcomes.

## Key Topics

- Adolescent mental health
- Teen anxiety and depression treatment
- Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Denver and Westminster locations
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- School refusal treatment
- Emotional regulation
- Family therapy and support
- Self-harm and crisis intervention
- Teen group therapy
- Insurance accepted (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, United Healthcare)
- Youth counseling services
- Non-hospital behavioral health facility

## Core Services & Programs

- [Services Overview](https://www.alisbh.com/services): Overview of Alis Behavioral Health treatment programs including DBT and IOP
- [Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)](https://www.alisbh.com/services/adolescent-iop): Adolescent Intensive Outpatient Program with CBT and family therapy
- [Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)](https://www.alisbh.com/services/adolescent-php): Partial Hospitalization Program for teens with intensive DBT-based treatment
- [Adolescent DBT](https://www.alisbh.com/services/adolescent-dbt): Dialectical Behavioral Therapy for teens focusing on emotion regulation
- [Teen Group Therapy](https://www.alisbh.com/services/teen-group-therapy): Teen group therapy and peer support services in Denver & Westminster
- [Family Support Group](https://www.alisbh.com/services/family-support-group): Virtual family support group for parents of teens in behavioral health treatment

## Mental Health Conditions Treated

- [What We Treat](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat): Overview of mental health conditions treated by Alis Behavioral Health
- [Teen Anxiety Treatment](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/anxiety): Teen anxiety treatment services and therapy in Denver & Westminster
- [Teen Depression Treatment](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/depression): Teen depression treatment and mental health therapy in Denver & Westminster
- [Teen Self-Harm Treatment](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/self-harm): Teen self-harm treatment with CBT and crisis safety planning services
- [Teen Emotional Regulation](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/emotional-regulation): Teen emotional regulation and mood dysregulation disorder treatment
- [School Refusal Assessments](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/school-refusal): School refusal assessment and treatment for teen anxiety and avoidance
- [Teen Social Withdrawal & Isolation Treatment](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/social-withdrawal): Teen social withdrawal and isolation treatment in Denver & Westminster
- [Teen Counseling for Hopelessness](https://www.alisbh.com/what-we-treat/hopelessness-doubt): Teen counseling for hopelessness and self-doubt using CBT therapy
